title: a16z Podcast: Apple and the Case of Invisible But Audible Innovation

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: "Apple isn't just a tech company; it's a tastemaker." Remember the iconic ads of dancing silhouettes in black.
reader_summary.overview: "Apple isn't just a tech company; it's a tastemaker." Remember the iconic ads of dancing silhouettes in black, with only the headphone wires visible in white? They were a critical part of the larger buy-Apple innovation narrative. So what happens now when those wires -- an emblematic and enduring image -- are no longer visible.

key_points.text: So what happens now when those wires -- an emblematic and enduring image -- are no longer visible.
It's part of a broader story, both about how product narratives are shared/told and about how innovation happens: "amazingly", subtly, and sometimes, invisibly.
